· Position vs SMA100/200 ($0.19/$0.22) — mixed mid/long-term trend.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (62.3→69.1) + entering overbought + sustained upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0019→0.0002) + slowing improvement diagnosed + strong expansion maintained.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $0.21) + widening band range.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.16) + Pivot S1 ($0.18) and SMA20 ($0.19) support.
· Swing resistance ($0.21) + expectation of further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + continued recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (3.54x) + increased confidence in upward movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + consider buying on breakout above $0.21 resistance.
